notes.title: Patch Version 2.02
notes.content: Changes the timing/trigger method of some jump scares to prevent them from being missed, removes some that just don't fit or overbear the game.

notes.title: Patch v2.01
notes.content: Patches an issue causing the lighter to become unable to be used.  Fixed objects that are not meant to be interacted with.  Deleted a development save that could be loaded causing bugs at the end of the game.  Fixed some grammatical errors.

notes.title: Update Version 2.00
notes.content: This update fixes a few subtitle bugs but mostly adds detail to environments in the last half of the game as well as several new scares.

notes.title: Version 1.12 Achievement Patch
notes.content: This patch should fix the issue of unlocking achievements as well as a few quality-of-life fixes.  If users still notice an error with achievements/stats, please let me know so I can continue to find a solution.

notes.title: Update Version 1.1
notes.content: Collision bug is now fixed, and game can be played without interruption.

notes.title: IMPORTANT SMALL PATCH! Please install before playing.
notes.content: This will be the most recent patch.
